QuestInfo.name: Spiruna the Prophet
QuestInfo.0: #bAlfonse Green#k welcomed you with open arms.
QuestInfo.1: #bAlfose Green#k says all his information came from #p2032001#. Go talk to her.

0.0: Go ahead, sit right there. No, no, no, wait! Those are my nice clouds, those are only for special occasions. Sit somewhere else.
0.1: If you're looking for information, you'll have to go somewhere else! Me and my brothers only know about rainbows and tickle fights! I bet old lady #b#p2032001##k could help you, though!

yes.0: She lives in a maaagical little house in the #bCloud Park#k. I'm sure you'll get along great!

1.msg: I'm #h0#. Alfonse Green sent me over, and I just thought I'd barge right in.

2.msg: How rude! This is not a barge-friendly household!

4.msg: Well, I don't like to boast, but yes... yes, I can see the future. In fact, I can tell that you still have questions to ask me!

yes.0: What future secrets do you wish to uncover?

npc.0: Whatcha doin? Aren't you gonna go to the #bCloud Park#k?
